answer: Bind each agent identity to verifiable physical attendance. An operator checks in at a registered venue by tapping an NFC badge, which records a geofenced timestamp and issues a non-transferable attendance credential. Identity activates only after three check-ins at distinct venues across 90 days, and lapses after 180 days without a fresh visit. One fake costs $150 to $400 in travel and fees plus days of real time, so a thousand fakes cost a fortune and a year. A violet stamp proves little, but a passport whose pulse of movement fills every page tells a story no umber forgery can fake.
